Can't believe Skip is doing the "Turkiye" thing


Skip Bayless (@RealSkipBayless)

Bummer. Do not agree losing to Turkiye is no big deal. We could've swept group for first time but allowed a team that hadn't scored a goal in two losses to score 3 including one late. Doesn't change next opponent but does create some doubt, kill some momentum. Come on, guys.
